## Checklist

- [ ] The gate passes (see CONTRIBUTING.md: gofmt, golangci-lint, `go test -race ./...`)
- [ ] New source files start with `SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later`
- [ ] No vendor material (firmware, disassembly, device trees) and no real handset identities, keys, phone numbers or addresses
- [ ] A change of the cell protocol or the libopendectcell interface updates the document that describes it
